import torch


def compute(**kwargs):
    Z = torch.as_tensor(kwargs['Z'], dtype=torch.float64).reshape(-1)
    theta = torch.as_tensor(kwargs['theta'], dtype=torch.float64).reshape(-1)
    s = torch.as_tensor(kwargs['s'], dtype=torch.float64)
    M = torch.as_tensor(kwargs['M'], dtype=torch.float64).reshape(-1)
    use_behaviour = torch.as_tensor(kwargs['use_behaviour'], dtype=torch.float64)
    use_curvature = torch.as_tensor(kwargs['use_curvature'], dtype=torch.float64)
    _ = use_curvature

    r0 = Z[0] / s
    r1 = Z[1] / s
    rL0 = torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.float64, device=Z.device)
    rL1 = r0
    rL2 = r1

    vpi0 = use_behaviour * M[0]
    vpi1 = use_behaviour * M[1]
    nv = torch.sqrt(vpi0 * vpi0 + vpi1 * vpi1 + 1e-24)
    m0 = torch.cosh(nv)
    m1 = torch.sinh(nv) * vpi0 / nv
    m2 = torch.sinh(nv) * vpi1 / nv

    inner1 = m1 * theta[0] + m2 * theta[1]
    den1 = 1.0 + m0
    p10 = inner1 * (1.0 + m0) / den1
    p11 = theta[0] + inner1 * m1 / den1
    p12 = theta[1] + inner1 * m2 / den1

    inner2 = -p10
    den2 = 1.0 + m0
    W0 = p10 + inner2 * (1.0 + m0) / den2
    W1 = p11 + inner2 * m1 / den2
    W2 = p12 + inner2 * m2 / den2

    e0 = rL0 - W0
    e1 = rL1 - W1
    e2 = rL2 - W2
    d2 = -e0 * e0 + e1 * e1 + e2 * e2
    loss = d2
    return loss.reshape(1)
